mn106:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kurūsu viharati. Kammassadhamman nāma Kurūnaṃ nigamo.
mn106:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn106:2.1: Aniccā, bhikkhave, kāmā tucchā musā moghadhammā;
mn106:2.3: Ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā, ye ca samparāyikā kāmā,
mn106:2.4: yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā,
mn106:2.5: ubhayam etaṃ Māradheyyaṃ, Mārass' esa visayo, Mārass' esa nivāpo, Mārass' esa gocaro.
mn106:2.6: Etth' ete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā pi vyāpādā pi sārambhā pi saṃvattanti,
mn106:2.7: te ca ariyasāvakassa idhamanusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti .
mn106:3.2: Ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā ye ca samparāyikā . . .
mn106:3.7: Yannunāhaṃ vipulena mahaggatena cetasā vihareyyaṃ abhibhuyya lokaṃ adhiṭṭhāya manasā.
mn106:3.8: Vipulena hi me mahaggatena cetasā viharato abhibhuyya lokaṃ adhiṭṭhāya manasā, ye pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā pi vyāpādā pi sārambhā pi, te na bhavissanti,
mn106:3.9: tesaṃ pahānā aparittañ ca me cittaṃ bhavissati, appamāṇaṃ subhāvitan ti.
mn106:3.10: Tassa evaṃ paṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:3.11: sampasāde sati, etarahi vā āṇañjaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:3.12: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āṇañjūpagaṃ.
mn106:3.13: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā āṇañjasappāya paṭipadā akkhāyati.
mn106:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti patisañcikkhati:
mn106:4.2: Ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā, ye ca samparāyikā kāmā,
mn106:4.3: yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā,
mn106:4.4: yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ cattāri ca mahābhūtāni catunnañ ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya sabbaṃ rūpan ti.
mn106:4.5: Tassa evaṃ paṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:4.6: sampasāde sati etarahi vā āṇañjaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:4.7: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati yaṃ, taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āṇañjūpagaṃ.
mn106:4.8: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyā āṇañjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
mn106:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn106:5.2: Ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā ye ca samparāyikā kāmā,
mn106:5.3: yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā,
mn106:5.4: ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā rūpā ye ca samparāyikā rūpā,
mn106:5.5: yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā rūpasaññā , yā ca samparāyikā rūpā, yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā rūpasaññā,
mn106:5.6: yā ca samparāyikā rūpasaññā, ubhayam etaṃ aniccaṃ.
mn106:5.7: Yad aniccaṃ taṃ nālaṃ abhinandituṃ, nālaṃ abhivadituṃ, nālaṃ ajjhositun ti.
mn106:5.8: Tassa evaṃ paṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:5.9: sampasāde sati etarahi vā āṇañjaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:5.10: Kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āṇañjūpagaṃ.
mn106:5.11: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyā āṇañjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
mn106:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn106:6.8: yatth' etā aparisesā nirujjhanti, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ
mn106:6.10: Tassa evaṃ paṭipaṇṇassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:6.11: sampasāde sati etarahi vā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:6.12: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa ākiñcaññāyatanūpagaṃ.
mn106:6.13: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā ākiñcaññāyatanasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
mn106:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn106:7.2: Suññam idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā ti.
mn106:7.3: Tassa evaṃ paṭipaṇṇassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:7.4: sampasāde sati etarahi vā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:7.5: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa ākiñcaññāyatanūpagaṃ.
mn106:7.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyā ākiñcaññāyatanasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
mn106:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn106:8.2: Nāhaṃ kvacani, kassaci kiñcanatasmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani kismiñci kiñcanaṃ na 'tthīti.
mn106:8.3: Tassa evaṃ paṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:8.4: sampasāde sati etarahi vā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:8.5: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa ākiñcaññāyatanūpagaṃ.
mn106:8.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyā ākiñcaññāyatanasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
mn106:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn106:9.8: yatth' etā aparisesā nirujjhanti, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ
mn106:9.10: Tassa evaṃ paṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati
mn106:9.11: sampasāde sati etarahi vā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjati, paññāya vā adhimuccati.
mn106:9.12: Kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃ saṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagaṃ.
mn106:10.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn106:10.2: Idha, bhante, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:
mn106:10.3: No c' assa, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissati, yad atthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti
mn106:10.5: Parinibbāyi nu kho eso, bhante, bhikkhūti?
mn106:10.6: Ap' etth' ekacco, Ānanda, bhikkhu parinibbāyeyya. Ap' etth' ekacco bhikkhu na parinibbāyeyyāti.
mn106:10.7: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena ap' etth' ekacco bhikkhu parinibbāyeyya, ap' etth' ekacco bhikkhu na parinibbāyeyyāti?
mn106:10.8: Idh', Ānanda, bhikkhu evam paṭipanno hoti:
mn106:10.9: No c' assa, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissati, yad atthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti
mn106:10.11: So taṃ upekhaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn106:10.12: Tassa taṃ upekkhaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tan-nissitaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ tad-upādānaṃ .
mn106:11.1: Kahaṃ pana so, bhante, bhikkhu upādiyamāno upādiyatīti?
mn106:11.3: Upādānaseṭṭhaṃ kira so, bhante, bhikkhu upādiyamāno upādiyatīti.
mn106:11.4: Upādānaseṭṭhaṃ so, Ānanda, bhikkhu upādiyamāno upādiyati.
mn106:12.1: Idh', Ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti:
mn106:12.2: No c' assa, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissati, yad atthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti
mn106:12.4: So taṃ upekhaṃ nābhinandati, nābhivadati, na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn106:12.5: Tassa taṃ upekhaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tan-nissitaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ na tad-upādānaṃ .
mn106:13.2: Nissāya nissāya kira no, bhante, Bhagavatā oghassa nittharaṇā akkhātā.
mn106:13.3: Katamo pana, bhante, ariyo vimokho ti?
mn106:13.5: Ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā ye ca samparāyikā kāmā,
mn106:13.6: yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā,
mn106:13.7: ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā rūpā ye ca samparāyikā rūpā,
mn106:13.8: yā ca diṭṭha dhammikā rūpasaññā yā ca samparāyikā rūpasaññā,
mn106:13.9: yā ca āṇañjasaññā, yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā, yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññā,
mn106:13.11: etaṃ amataṃ yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokho.
mn106:14.1: Iti kho, Ānanda, desitā mayā āṇañjasappāyā paṭipadā, desitā ākiñcaññāyatanasappāyā paṭipadā, desitā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasappāyā paṭipadā, desitā nissāya nissāya oghassa nittharaṇā, desito ariyo vimokho.
mn106:15.1: Yaṃ kho, Ānanda, Satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo tam mayā.
mn106:15.2: Etāni, Ānanda, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni, Jhāyath', Ānanda, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
mn106:15.4: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
